display.purpose: Concise page meaning and monthly status.

financial.purpose: Stable EGP values in summaries and lists.

components.name: Primary Expense Action
components.description: Persistent, labeled entry action for expense capture.
components.css: .ds-expense { min-height:56px; padding:0 18px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#BA6649; color:#FFFAF5; font:700 15px Arial,sans-serif; box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgb(15 28 43 / .14); } .ds-expense:hover { background:#93472f; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-expense:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #075f82; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Allocation Track
components.description: Spent and remaining are a single clear divided financial line.

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A status always combines Arabic text with a semantic color.

narrative.overview: Dabber presents a shared month as deliberate allocations, not a generic finance dashboard. Warm paper and restrained divisions make financial status readable before decoration.

rules.name: Deliberate Accent
rules.body: Terracotta identifies intentional action and actual spent progress; it is never general decoration.

dos: Use semantic UI tokens derived from Brand v1.
Pair progress with explicit financial amounts and labels.
donts: Do not redraw or replace official brand assets.
Do not use generic donut charts or color-only status.
